address: 50 Great Cumberland Place, Marble Arch, London,W1H 7FD
bio: Treat yourself to a luxury Japanese-inspired Afternoon Tea at The Malt Lounge and Bar and find yourself transported right across the globe.  Nestled within the walls of The Prince Akatoki Hotel, The Malt Lounge and Bar oozes elegance and tranquility. Their Afternoon Tea menu fuses together elements of Japanese and British cuisine to create an Afternoon Tea experience like no other.  Located in the heart of London's West End, The Prince Akatoki Hotel is just a stone's throw from Marble Arch Tube Station. It also finds itself within easy reach of some of London's best green spaces, including Hyde Park and Kensington Gardens.
